notes.title: Team Deathmatch Has Landed!
notes.content:
Hey Worms!

The new Team Deathmatch mode has landed in Worms Rumble! It's time to take a side and battle in 12v12 real-time action! Get ready to rumble in smaller versions of the 32 player maps, reshaped by a permanent storm. Plus, gain double XP through to the end of this weekend! Read more on the full update below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/d8784aced171bfffb50337c33950454d4645a6dc.jpg[/img]

Haven't heard of Worms Rumble before? Well - it's an arena based real-time shooter with up to 32 players, with battle royal, deathmatch and experimental modes. Wield classic Worms weaponry like the iconic holy hand grenade and even get blasting with new ones like the powerful Hammerhead rocket launcher. Worms Rumble also has crossplay between PC, PS4 and PS5!

Check out the launch trailer here:

[previewyoutube=pbNWUMnC328;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Team Deathmatch[/h1]

Take up the call of team based total Wormfare with the new Team Deathmatch mode! Be assigned to red or blue team in a battle to rack up the most kills and find yourself in 12v12 arena based controlled chaos. This game mode was highly requested in the community and we were eager to get it in. We've also changed the maps to be smaller based on community feedback from an open beta on the mode, expect to see storms at the edges of maps from the 32 player mode!

It's time to hop into the action and fight for your teams victory!

[h1]Double XP Weekend[/h1]

To celebrate the launch of the new mode and update, we are starting the first double XP weekend starting today at 3PM GMT through to Monday 3PM GMT. Hop in game for double the xp gain and get rewarded with cosmetics to make your Worm look the best they can be. There's never been a better time to rumble!

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

Again, we have been listening closely to everyone's feedback and some of the issues you have faced. We have made a few fixes and improvements that should help make many of your game experiences better!

[b]Crash fixes:[/b] we have fixed several of the most common crash issues effecting players. The way we get the best data is when people send the crash reports from the prompt after their game has closed which has helped us track down and solve these biggest issues so far. If you come across any new issues please be sure to click send info if you get this prompt and you can also contact our support team here: Support

[b]Network Improvements:[/b] we have made some improvement to network issues players were having including several issues of delay/jitter. We will continue to monitor and improve this as it will be continually improved upon.

[b]Full fix notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixes for multiple crashes seen across all platforms
[*] Fixes / optimisations for general network gameplay
[*] Fixed a desync issue when using the Grapple Gun and Jetpack
[*] Fixed an issue where the small banner displayed the incorrect player while specating
[*] The News feed articles are now correctly translated in all languages
[*] Fixed an issue where the jetpack wasn't removed from the player's inventory when the item's durability reached 0
[*] Fixed an issue where the player was unable to jump after taking fall damage
[*] Fixed an issue where certain emotes were displayed incorrectly
[*] Fixed an issue where the player was unable to accept invites on PlayStation
[*] Fixed an issue where Team17 friends online status was displayed incorrectly
[*] Fixed a visual issue when the main menu background was not loaded correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where the player was unable to search for a Lab mode after the search was cancelled
[*] Fixed an issue where the pre-game information was not displayed
[/list]

Thanks for reading all, we still have much more planned and you can see our short term development roadmap here going into Febuary:

notes.title: Worms Rumble Team Deathmatch Coming Soon, Rising Tide Lab Mode & Dev Roadmap!
notes.content:
Hey Worms!

We've been listening closely to community requests and are excited to reveal that a team death match mode will be landing in Worms Rumble on January 28th 2021! 

[h3]TDM Mode[/h3]

A classic team vs team deathmatch mode is coming to the game next week. Take up the banner of the red or blue team and show the enemy the true meaning of collective Worms fire power!

This mode will be 12v12 and the maps will be reduced in size from the 32 player variants with some areas cut off with storms.

Thanks to everyone who joined our beta tests and helped us try out the new mode. We've listened to your feedback and tweaked the originally more chaotic mode! Spawns, map size and flow were critiques we've listened to and changed to make the mode better!

[h3]Roadmap[/h3]

Worms, we want to show you that we have much more content planned and for that we've put together a development roadmap that highlights some of the things coming in the near future!

notes.title: Worms Rumble Is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Worms Rumble has just landed here on Steam and is available to purchase, download and play! Don your jet pack and thrust yourself into the first ever real time Worms game! Take on epic 32 player battle royale or deathmatch modes right now! Plus get into the action quickly with matches with crossplay with other platforms.

[b]Watch the action packed launch trailer here:[/b]

[previewyoutube=pbNWUMnC328;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's some of the action you can expect of Worms Rumble:

[h3]3 Modes[/h3]

Take on the battle royale mode in Last Worm Standing or with 2 friends in the Squads mode. If that's not your cup of tea you can roll into the death match mode and hone your skills whilst respawning straight back into the action if you stand too close to a blossoming banana bomb.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xiICMPv9gISXe8cLcH/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]32 player transforming maps[/h3]

As of launch there are 3 maps designed full of funny references, iconic landmarks and strategic areas to get the upper hand on opponents. The maps can also have the chance to transform mid way through the battle with missile launches and even portals opening to shake up the match.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/W4BYuts2fmQjktoVvP/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Equip a whole host of powerful classic and new weaponry![/h3]

Wield classic weaponry from the Worms series, like the devastating holy hand grenade and also equip yourself with completely new guns like the projectile bouncing plasma launcher.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ukpf5NU3Knkrjm5poS/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Customise your worm to the max[/h3]

Don't look like a basic worm... well actually you can but if you want to really get ahead on the worm walkway then there's so many options open to you! Felt like a dinosaur on the outside but on the inside you were worm... don't worry we've got the outfit for that! Plus, match many accessories to get a completely custom look. You will get xp in the matches to unlock new tiers of outfits and customisations to how you are presented in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/9431751ffdbf709119affa4f354e58c8fc644fb4.png[/img]

[h3]Don't wriggle around the maps[/h3]

In Worms Rumble, movement is key! Roll around the map to speed up and also scale walls with extra jumps but be careful as you'll need to carefully manage your stamina! Also, find classic equipment to give you an extra edge like the jetpack and utility belt which can take you to the skies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/b71808fd83c421602b5b43859929000a51938ea1.gif[/img]

[h3]Come up with unique ways to play and gain the edge[/h3]

Come up with unique tactics to gain the edge on your enemies whether that be returning a foes rocket with your baseball bat or shielding a teammate to be revived and become the 'Last Worm Standing'

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bdh4zAw.gif[/img]

notes.title: Worms Rumble - Launching December & Open Beta November 6th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Today we’re incredibly excited to announce that Worms Rumble will be launching on Steam this December! 

To celebrate this awesome news we’ve put together a new trailer for you that reveals a new, never before seen level as well as some new items…

[previewyoutube=YCSWCEAgRzQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's take a look at some of the new trailer reveals shall we!


[h1]Introducing Portal Park[/h1]

Say “Hello!” to the second map revealed for Worms Rumble, Portal Park!

This sprawling map built inside a sports stadium features a mix of wide open spaces and close quarter combat scenarios, challenging players to adapt their fighting styles on the fly, unless they want to eat a Bazooka to the face…

The map itself is split into two distinct areas, with the upper area featuring the stadium, a giant map altering portal (more on that at a later date) and a focus on artillery and aerial style combat.

The second area, found in the lower half of the map, is built around underground train tracks where players will be CQC weapons to be most effective as you fight train to train and launch ambushes from hidden vents, so make sure you’ve got your shotguns and a spare grenade or two when entering this area!

Oh and did we mention that the trains move! Savvy worms will be able to hitch a ride to rapidly cross the width of the map… Just try not to end up on the windscreen though! 


[h1]New Mobility Gadgets[/h1]

We’ve seen you asking about what mobility options will be available in Worms Rumble and today we’re pleased to officially reveal two of them! (Yes, for those wondering, there’s more.)

As we all know, the ability to move around the map in a quick and stylish fashion is a key Worms feature and that’s no different in Rumble, so let’s take a look at what you’ll be getting to grips with:


[b]The Grappling Gun[/b]

A close cousin of the Ninja Rope, the Grappling Gun rewards skillful worms with unrivaled mobility and speed, allowing you to swiftly navigate through the map, change your momentum and even access hard to reach locations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/625ea63abe431a54d4cb607cd2a9ee88a4382f3e.gif[/img]

Worms that become comfortable with this tool will also find many useful applications for the Grappling Gun during a firefight too…


[b]The Jetpack[/b]

The classic Jetpack is back and ready to take your worm to the skies!

This tool is perfect for use in open spaces and larger rooms, giving you the ability to rain down destruction from above or fly above the carnage of an enemy Banana Bomb. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/b71808fd83c421602b5b43859929000a51938ea1.gif[/img]

Perfect for ambushing enemies from above or quickly escaping a losing battle, Jetpack users should be aware that whilst highly mobile they are vulnerable to precision weapons whilst hovering, so unless you’re wanting to visit the respawn screen try and avoid that!


[b]Fashion - The True Endgame?[/b]

Just like its peers, Worms Rumble will be packed full of cosmetics for you to customise your worm and make them unique. 

Some of these will be available from the start, with lots more being unlocked by just playing the game however you like and progressing through the ranks, using your preferred weapons and completing special challenges.

As a special thank you to those that pre-order Worms Rumble here on Steam we’ll also be giving them a unique cosmetic pack known as the ‘New Challenger’ bonus pack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/32361d7d3396f47ff03342e044dc07f74e458276.png[/img]


[h1]Crossplay Open Beta - Starting November 6th![/h1]

Get stuck into Worms Rumble ahead of launch with our crossplay open beta starting on November 6th! 

With no sign-up required you’ll be able to jump straight into the action alone or with friends as you clash with players both here on Steam and on console. 

We’ll be revealing more about the beta over the coming weeks, so watch this space!


[h1]Pre-order Worms Rumble Now![/h1]

If you like what you’ve seen you can pre-order Worms Rumble from right now to secure your exclusive cosmetic pack and support us ahead of launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186040/Worms_Rumble/

You can also support us with a Wishlist if you’re not ready to pre-order just yet!


We hope you enjoyed today’s news, we look forward to chatting about it with you over on the forums and then hurling a Holy Hand Grenade or two at you in the beta on November 6th.

notes.title: Worms Rumble: Closed Beta Patch #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We hope you are enjoying the Worms Rumble beta so far – keep those feedback threads and bug reports coming!

We’ve just released a patch to address the following issues:
[list]
[*]Fixed Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Portuguese-Brazilian always showing in English.
[*]Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Korean will now display the correct fonts.
[*]Bazooka rockets should now always shoot at the correct speed.
[*]Reflected projectiles from the Baseball bat should now visibly change direction.
[*]Fixed an issue with duplicate projectiles being spawned.
[*]Fixed an issue where the weapon state would desync with the server and you are left unable to reload/shoot your weapon.
[*]When a player disconnects during loading, the game should now always proceed into game.
[*]Fixed a rare server crash.
[*]XP and Currency should no longer be awarded from self-kills.
[*]Fixed an discrepancy in damage numbers across multiple UI screens.
[*]Various customisation items have had their names fixed to reflect the material applied.
[*]Fixed an issue where repeated audio can be heard when levelling up from rank 9 to 10.
[*]Fixed an issue when re-rolling your daily challenge would show incorrect progress. 
[/list]

We are looking to address the below remaining known issues during the beta too:
[list]
[*]Post-game flow doesn’t progress automatically on the player XP breakdown if player rank is maxed out. ‘Advance’ button needs to be pressed by the player. This will only happen when the player ranks up from lvl 9 – 10. A fix will be out before players reach this
[*]Desync might be seen while attempting to perform multiple consecutive wall jumps
[*]Flickering effect is present across background textures. This isn’t occurring for all players, and only seems to be happening on medium quality settings
[*]The top player listed on the player list appears twice during the pre-game flow. We’ve noticed other duplications of players on the list at times also
[*]Player's camera perspective sometimes changes immediately after dying. This only happens the first time the player dies
[*]Re-rolled daily challenges show existing progress, suggesting that progress is added whilst they're inactive
[*]The worm can occasionally disappear from the Worm tab preview
[*]The levelling up sound effect on the post-game flow continues to play on an account that has reached level 10
[/list]

That wraps up our first Beta patch! 

We hope you're all having a great time, we're looking forward to going through your feedback. From bugs to your thoughts and suggestions on what you like AND would like to see in the game go let us know!
